title: Dead Flies and Folly

questions.question: Dead flies make the perfumer's ointment give off a what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:1 (ESV): "Dead flies make the perfumer's ointment give off a stench;"

questions.question: A wise man's heart inclines him to the right, but a fool's heart to the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:2 (ESV): "but a fool's heart to the left."

questions.question: He who digs a pit will fall into it, and a serpent will bite him who breaks through a what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:8 (ESV): "and a serpent will bite him who breaks through a wall."

questions.question: If the iron is blunt, and one does not sharpen the edge, he must use more what?
A feast is made for laughter, and wine gladdens life, and money answers what?
So a little folly outweighs wisdom and what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:1 (ESV): "so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor."

questions.question: Even when the fool walks on the road, he lacks what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:3 (ESV): "Even when the fool walks on the road, he lacks sense,"

questions.question: If the anger of the ruler rises against you, do not leave your what?
I have seen slaves on horses, and princes walking on the ground like what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:7 (ESV): "and princes walking on the ground like slaves."

questions.question: The words of a wise man's mouth win him favor, but the lips of a fool consume whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:12 (ESV): "but the lips of a fool consume him."

questions.question: He who quarries stones is hurt by them, and he who splits logs is endangered by whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:9 (ESV): "and he who splits logs is endangered by them."

questions.question: If the serpent bites before it is charmed, there is no advantage to the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:11 (ESV): "there is no advantage to the charmer."

questions.question: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness, and the end of his talk is evil what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:13 (ESV): "and the end of his talk is evil madness."

questions.question: Woe to you, O land, when your king is a child, and your princes feast in the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:16 (ESV): "and your princes feast in the morning!"

questions.question: Through sloth the roof sinks in, and through indolence the house does what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 10:18 (ESV): "and through indolence the house leaks."

key_verse_text: Dead flies make the perfumer's ointment give off a stench; so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.
